Luke James for Engadget Add Engadget on Google: Preferred Source Google Discover Take the side panel off a gaming PC and the graphics card is the first thing you'll see. It's a slab the size of a hardback book slotted into the motherboard with fans bolted to it. But open up a PlayStation 5 or Xbox Series X and you'll see nothing of the kind. Instead, beneath the heatsink sits an AMD chip doing the work of both processor and graphics card.

stories.title: San Antonio is most popular location for an NFL team expansion, survey finds
stories.summary: Nineteen percent of those surveyed said they would like to see an NFL franchise in the Alamo City. Nineteen percent of the 1,000 NFL fans surveyed by Betway Insider said they would like to see a franchise in the Alamo City, making it the most popular choice for an expansion team. San Antonio edged out Oklahoma City by just seven votes, despite both cities receiving 19% of the vote. The Lone Star state already has two NFL teams, the Dallas Cowboys and Houston Texans, but that didn't stop fans from calling for more. Austin took fifth place in the survey, with 14% of respondents saying they'd like to see a team there.
